subject.title: fix(doctor): register local audio health check

question: Should ordinary doctor suppress informational health findings, render them without failing health, or continue treating every non-empty finding as an unhealthy warning?
rationale: The merged replacement and this PR choose different user-visible behavior, while the shared typed severity contract suggests a broader durable fix that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Make the bridge severity-aware
options.body: Handle `info` findings without setting unhealthy status while retaining warning/error behavior for all shared callers.

options.title: Keep the local no-op
options.body: Resolve the conflict in favor of this PR's lint-only runner and leave the shared bridge unchanged.

options.title: Keep current warning behavior
options.body: Close this PR and intentionally let local-audio informational inventory appear as an unhealthy doctor warning.

recommendation.title: Make the bridge severity-aware
recommendation.body: Handle `info` findings without setting unhealthy status while retaining warning/error behavior for all shared callers.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored both competing implementations and has the strongest direct history signal for this doctor behavior choice.
